services.title: Home Care Assistance
services.summary: Support with everyday activities, routines, and comfortable living in the familiar surroundings of home.
services.fullDescription: Our home care assistance is designed to support individuals who value living in their own homes but need a dependable helping hand with day-to-day routines. We assist with meal preparation, mobility, household reminders, light housekeeping, and personal comfort while respecting client independence.
services.whoMayBenefit: Individuals needing extra support at home, seniors wishing to age in place, and individuals recuperating after an illness.
supportExamples: Nutritious meal preparation and hydration monitoring
Assistance with morning and evening routines
Light housekeeping, tidy living spaces, and laundry support
Mobility assistance and safe movement within the house
Accompaniment to hospital appointments and walks
Friendly companionship and cognitive engagement

services.title: Elderly Care
services.summary: Respectful, patient assistance that upholds comfort, dignity, safety, independence, and overall wellbeing.
services.fullDescription: Aging brings changes in physical capability, emotional needs, and daily routines. Our elderly care team provides compassionate, attentive support tailored to older adults. We focus on fall prevention, medication adherence reminders, gentle exercise encouragement, dignity in personal grooming, and genuine companionship.
services.whoMayBenefit: Elderly parents, seniors living alone or with family in Lagos, and older adults experiencing age-related physical limitations.
supportExamples: Dignified assistance with bathing, dressing, and grooming
Fall risk management and supervised safe walking
Medication schedule prompts and vitals check coordination
Engaging conversations, reading, and mental wellness activities
Monitoring mood, sleep, appetite, and general health changes
Regular reassuring updates for family members

services.title: Personal Care Assistance
services.summary: Help with suitable activities of daily living according to each client’s needs and agreed care plan.
services.fullDescription: Personal care requires tact, respect, and skilled hands. Our trained caregivers assist with sensitive daily living routines with utmost privacy and dignity. We adhere strictly to agreed care plans, ensuring our clients feel clean, comfortable, and confident.
services.whoMayBenefit: Individuals with limited mobility, bed-bound clients, or those recovering who require hands-on daily support.
supportExamples: Bed bath, shower, and personal hygiene assistance
Oral care, skin care, and pressure-sore prevention positioning
Toileting and incontinence care managed respectfully
Assistance with feeding and dietary routines
Safe transfer assistance from bed to wheelchair or chair

services.title: Nursing Support
services.summary: Skilled nursing services delivered by appropriately qualified nursing professionals within their professional competence.
services.fullDescription: When medical needs arise at home, our registered nursing personnel provide competent clinical support under medical direction. From wound care and vital signs monitoring to catheter care and post-operative monitoring, our nurses bring hospital-level dedication into your home.
services.whoMayBenefit: Post-operative patients, clients with chronic clinical conditions, individuals requiring clinical monitoring or professional wound dressing.
supportExamples: Comprehensive vital signs monitoring and clinical documentation
Aseptic wound dressing, surgical site care, and ulcer management
Prescribed medication administration and injection support
Catheter care, stoma support, and tube feeding monitoring
Direct liaison with attending physicians and hospital teams

services.title: Recovery and Respite Support
services.summary: Support for individuals recovering at home and short-term relief for family members who provide primary care.
services.fullDescription: Caring for a loved one is rewarding but can also be physically and emotionally demanding. Our respite care gives family caregivers time to rest, attend to work, or travel, knowing their loved one is in safe, professional hands. We also assist patients transitioning back home after hospital discharge.
services.whoMayBenefit: Family caregivers needing short-term relief, and patients recovering from surgery, stroke, or acute medical illness.
supportExamples: Flexible short-term, weekend, or multi-week respite coverage
Post-hospital discharge rehabilitation support and observation
Continuity of daily routines and medication schedules
Physical therapy exercise assistance following doctor instructions
Relief for primary family caregivers to prevent burnout

services.title: Family Care Support
services.summary: Practical assistance, professional guidance, and clear communication to help families coordinate appropriate care.
services.fullDescription: Navigating care options can feel overwhelming for families. AFNAAN acts as a dependable partner, conducting thorough needs assessments, setting up structured care routines, providing transparent daily updates, and adjusting care as needs evolve.
services.whoMayBenefit: Families in Lagos or in the diaspora wanting reliable, supervised care arrangements for their loved ones.
supportExamples: Initial home care assessment and individualised care planning
Direct WhatsApp and digital care progress updates to family
Caregiver supervision, attendance monitoring, and quality checks
Transparent communication regarding any changes in health status
Ongoing guidance on home safety and adaptive living equipment

Their punctuality, transparency, and clinical competence were outstanding. When my father required post-hospital recovery support, the nurse assigned by AFNAAN CARES was thorough and communicative.
The caregiver assigned to us treats my aunt with dignity and gentleness. The management team checks in regularly to make sure everything is running smoothly. Highly recommended.

His vision for AFNAAN CARES is to build a care service that listens to families, values dedicated care professionals, and places people’s wellbeing at the centre of every care arrangement.

Through AFNAAN CARES, he aims to encourage a culture of empathy, responsibility, trust, and continuous improvement in caregiving.

websiteSettings.privacyPolicy:
At AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver, we are dedicated to protecting your privacy and treating all personal and health-related information with maximum discretion, security, and confidentiality.

1. Information We Collect:
We collect contact information (names, email addresses, phone numbers), location details, care requirements, schedule preferences, and caregiver employment applications solely to coordinate care services or evaluate job applications. We do not collect unnecessary medical records or excessive personal data.

2. How We Use Your Information:
The information you submit is used exclusively to:
- Review and evaluate your home care or nursing support request.
- Contact you to discuss care arrangements and suitability.
- Process caregiver recruitment applications and verify credentials.
- Respond to enquiries submitted through our contact form.

3. Data Security & Confidentiality:
All care requests, caregiver records, and uploaded documents are stored in secure, access-controlled databases. We implement strict server-side safeguards, encryption, and authorization checks. We do not sell, rent, or disclose personal data to third parties.

4. Your Rights:
You have the right to request access to your submitted data, request corrections, or request deletion of your information by contacting our privacy officer at abooafnaan28@gmail.com.

5. Emergency Disclaimer:
AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver provides home care and nursing support services. Our website and services do not replace acute hospital emergency services. For immediate life-threatening medical emergencies, please contact emergency medical providers immediately.
websiteSettings.termsOfService:
Welcome to AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver. By accessing our website and engaging our services, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

1. Services Scope:
AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver provides non-clinical home care assistance, elderly care, personal care support, and clinical nursing support. Clinical nursing tasks are performed exclusively by appropriately qualified and authorised nursing professionals within applicable professional regulations.

2. Service Arrangements:
All care arrangements are subject to initial assessment, caregiver availability, mutual agreement, and written care service agreements. Submitting an enquiry through this website initiates an enquiry and does not constitute a binding contract until formal confirmation.

3. Accuracy of Information:
Users agree to provide accurate, truthful details regarding care requirements, client location, and caregiver credentials.

4. Emergency Notice:
Our care services are designed for planned home care, convalescent recovery, and assisted daily living. We are not an emergency dispatch service.

5. Modifications:
AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver reserves the right to modify website terms and service offerings in accordance with operational and regulatory requirements.
websiteSettings.accessibilityStatement:
AFNAAN CARES Nurses & Caregiver is committed to ensuring our digital services are accessible to all people, including seniors and individuals with disabilities.

- We follow WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility principles.
- Headings, text, and interactive elements maintain high contrast against backgrounds.
- All decorative and orbital animations respect the user's 'prefers-reduced-motion' system setting.
- Forms include clear labels, keyboard navigable inputs, and accessible error notifications.
- If you encounter any accessibility barrier on our website, please notify us at abooafnaan28@gmail.com so we can promptly address it.
